about: Lays out items in columns. `Grid.Root` sets the columns and `Grid.Item` sets how many columns an item spans.

align.about: Block alignment of each item in its row, with a short card beside one that wraps. Each item is the card itself.
align.title: Alignment

counts.about: Every column count from 1 to 12, each laying out 12 calendar days in an 896px room.
counts.title: Counts

day.about: An event at `span="1"` in a calendar of 12 columns. The title is a truncating `Text` without a card, because a card's inset is wider than a column at a 420px viewport.
day.title: One column

filled.about: One plan in a 672px room. `fit-xs` stretches the item across the row. `fill-xs` keeps the empty track, so the item keeps the 320px width.
filled.title: Fit and fill

fitted.about: Three plans at `fit-xs` in rooms of 320, 576 and 672px. The room holds as many 320px columns as fit, and the columns stretch over the row.
fitted.title: Fitted

flow.about: Auto-placement of a dashboard whose first two widgets span two of three columns. `dense` moves a later widget into the hole beside the first.
flow.title: Flow

gap.about: Every gap token between two columns and between the two rows the third plan wraps into.
gap.title: Gaps

justify.about: Inline alignment of each item in its column. Unset, the items stretch to the column.
justify.title: Justify

notes.overdue: Invoice INV-2039 is 14 days overdue. A reminder goes out tomorrow.

span.about: An event card at every span from 2 to `full` in a calendar of 12 columns, followed by the days after it. The title truncates when the card is too narrow for it.
span.title: Spans

title: Grid
